preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K is an integer between 2 and 9 inclusive.
The product of K raised to the power of N is greater than 1 and less than 4096.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string S is equal to K raised to the power of N plus N minus 1.

postconditions.expression: all(s in S for s in all_possible_strings)
postconditions.description: The output string S contains all possible strings of size N formed from characters 0 to K-1 as substrings.

postconditions.expression: not any(S.count(s) > 1 for s in all_possible_strings)
postconditions.description: The output string S does not contain any substring more than once.
